notes.title: Multilingual and Sound update
notes.content:
[b]Languages available in the are the following;[/b]
 Czech, Danish Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese Romanian, Spanish, Swedish.

[b]Sound Changes[/b]
The walking sound
The interact sounds
Some of the enemy sound
Elevator Sound
Random world SFX
and more
[i][Sounds may be altered in the future/i]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
Now collecting all of the achievements unlocks the bonus content

notes.title: Monthly update blog
notes.content: This update has changed the health system, now instead of a health bar players will have the screen quickly change colors to indicate damage dealt. There are a few new cut scenes and animations in the game now and the difficulty of the game has increased. Also, a new main menu has been added, where you can test game settings in the main menu. Also, there is somewhat of controller support, except in the menu but playing through the game controller does work.
